prompt.alinti: top five plugins to install in Claude. First is OmniRoute. It gives Claude code almost unlimited usage by connecting to over 300 AI API providers.
So the moment your usage limit runs out, it automatically switches you to the next best model, giving you up to 1.6 billion free tokens every single month.
The second is superpowers. It turns Claude from a single agent into an entire dev team.
So it will brainstorm with you, plan the build, write the tests, and review its own code before you can see it.
Third is called Caveman. This makes Claude talk to you like an actual caveman.
It strips out filler words and pleasantries so you get the exact same code while burning way fewer tokens.
The fourth is Claude Code Setup. This is an official Anthropic plugin that scans your entire codebase and recommends the best hooks, skills, sub-agents, and even MCP servers for your project.
It also removes unnecessary fluff. And finally, Claude Security. This is Anthropic's official security scanner.
It hunts through your codebase, finds vulnerabilities, and finds the holes before a hacker even gets the chance to.
